script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: It guesses why the leader kneels. The text does not give his reason.
The late-curfew joke brings in a modern parent-and-child scenario and trivializes the daughter's death.
The imagined line about finishing the lesson puts invented words in Jesus' mouth, even though it says He did not speak them.
The waiting-list joke puts the comparison on Jesus' action rather than on the human side of the moment.
It calls the woman's approach quiet and guesses that she was trying not to make a scene. The text gives neither detail.
The text does not say the fringe was hanging out the back of the cloak.
It asserts that the woman had a lot of patience. The text says she suffered for twelve years but does not describe her patience.
The text does not say the crowd came for a funeral, that they were unprepared for what happened, or that their laughter stopped.
The funeral and plot-twist joke makes light of the scene surrounding the girl's death.
The news spreading does not establish that nobody tried to keep it quiet.
